title: Euphrasia officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Euphrasia officinalis tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the greater eyebright plant. It has been traditionally used in herbalism to support eye health and alleviate symptoms of eye strain, redness, and irritation. This tea is often consumed as a calming infusion to promote overall wellness and soothe the nervous system. Its mild, earthy flavor makes it a popular choice for those seeking natural remedies for minor ailments. In herbal practice, it is also used to support the immune system and reduce inflammation.
